title: Status codes and closing bodies
hints: client.Get only returns an error when the request couldn't be made at all. A 404 or 500 is a successful round trip, so check resp.StatusCode yourself.
Return an error that includes resp.Status (for example "404 Not Found") when the status isn't http.StatusOK.
Every response body must be closed, or the connection can't be reused. Put defer resp.Body.Close() right after the error check on client.Get.
